DCTL.Reglage.enabled.Indic: Reads the gamepad plugged into this computer. Untick to ignore it without disabling the module.
DCTL.Reglage.deadzone.Indic: Share of the radius ignored at the centre of each stick, to avoid drift at rest.
DCTL.Reglage.holdMs.Indic: Past this, a press becomes a hold (for example holding Menu to end your turn).
DCTL.Reglage.magnet.Indic: The selection cursor slows down over clickable things (buttons, cells, menus, tokens) and centres on them when you let go of the stick.
DCTL.Reglage.cursorSpeed.Indic: Virtual cursor speed with the left stick fully tilted. A slight tilt stays precise.
DCTL.Reglage.panSpeed.Indic: Pan and scroll speed with the right stick fully tilted.
DCTL.Reglage.rumble.Indic: Makes the gamepad vibrate on game events (once they are wired).
DCTL.Reglage.padId.Indic: Exact gamepad id. Empty: the first standard gamepad. Easier to pick from the diagnostics.
DCTL.Diagnostic.Indic: Live buttons, sticks and triggers, and which gamepad is read.
DCTL.Diagnostic.Aucune: No gamepad seen. Press a gamepad button while Foundry has the focus.
DCTL.Roue.SansInterface: The action wheel needs DAS · Combat UI (darsh-dnd-ui 0.21.0 or later).
DCTL.Roue.Vide: No action in the Bar: select your character.
DCTL.Roue.Aide: Left stick: aim at an action
